selection_reasoning: This forms a natural multi-hop dependency: the agent must first mine carrots from a carrot crop in the scene, then sell those carrots to a farmer villager to obtain emeralds, and finally use those emeralds to trade for rabbit stew from the same or another farmer villager. This chain tests resource gathering (mining crops) followed by villager trading, creating a meaningful dependency where the output of task 1 (carrots) enables task 2 (trading for rabbit stew via emerald acquisition). Both tasks are observable and verifiable — carrot inventory and rabbit stew acquisition can be checked.

edges.reason: Agent must mine carrots to sell to a farmer villager for emeralds, which are then used to purchase rabbit stew

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining fully grown carrot crops (age=7) drops carrot items that the player picks up into inventory. The player starts with no carrots, so any carrot in inventory confirms successful mining. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory. min_count=1 is sufficient since the task is simply 'mine carrots' (not a specific quantity).

Uses inventory_has because trading with the farmer villager for rabbit stew places the item directly into the player's inventory. Rabbit stew is not available anywhere else in the scene (no chests, no crafting materials, no starting inventory), so its presence in inventory uniquely confirms a successful villager trade. inventory_has is the most direct and reliable check for trade-obtained items.

scene_description: A compact scene with a 7x6 fully-grown carrot farm on hydrated farmland and a farmer villager trading post enclosed in oak fences on a cobblestone platform. The villager has custom trades: buy 22 carrots for 1 emerald, sell 1 rabbit stew for 1 emerald. An open grass area connects the farm and trading post for easy navigation.
task_text: Mine carrots from the nearby farm, trade them to the farmer villager for emeralds, then trade an emerald for rabbit stew.
design_notes: Player spawns on grass at origin facing south toward carrot farm (z+3 to z+8). Farmer villager with NoAI is in fenced pen at z-4 (north of spawn). The 7x6 farm has 41 harvestable carrot crops (1 water block replaced). Villager has two custom trades: 22 carrots→1 emerald, 1 emerald→1 rabbit stew. Item IDs in NBT use unquoted short names (carrot, emerald, rabbit_stew) to avoid parsing issues. Cleared 31x31 area ensures no tree obstruction.
